pt_BR.help.title: at-deploy {version}

en_US.help.title: at-deploy {version}
en_US.help.no_args: With no word, at-deploy prints this help.
en_US.install.about: Puts at-deploy on the PATH, and the shell's completion
en_US.uninstall.about: Takes at-deploy off the PATH, and the completion
en_US.license.about: Says AT's license and what the artifact carries; `--include-texts` brings the third parties' texts
en_US.container.about: The container environment (§7a) — up, update, down, status, switch, forms, credential
en_US.up.about: Brings the environment and the services up, at the pinned images — the first time only
en_US.update.about: Puts the whole infra at this folder's binary pin — images, containers, all of it

en_US.status.about: Shows the folder's path and what is standing.
en_US.switch.about: The switch to the container path, transactional
en_US.forms.about: Returns AT to Forms mode: the environment down, and the Forms at the door
en_US.credential.about: Gives a person the credential the gate proves
en_US.host.about: The hosted path as a systemd --user service — up, update
en_US.host.up.about: Writes and enables the WebApp's and Authelia's systemd units — the first time only
en_US.host.update.about: Reapplies what changed in the units, without taking down what did not
en_US.wizard.credential.name: Whose credential is it? Type the name the gate asserts:
